name: Inbound WhatsApp webhook endpoint (verify, sign, normalize)
description:
## Context
Meta calls our API for every inbound WhatsApp event. It must be authenticated, idempotent and fast: processing happens off the request thread.

## Objective
`GET/POST /api/channels/whatsapp/webhook` + a normalizer.

## Steps
1. `codx/junior/api/channels.py` (router, later extended by the REST task):
   - `GET`: verify `hub.mode == "subscribe"` and `hub.verify_token == settings.whatsapp.verify_token`, return `hub.challenge` as plain text; 403 otherwise.
   - `POST`: read the RAW body, validate `X-Hub-Signature-256` = `sha256=<hmac(app_secret, raw_body)>` using `hmac.compare_digest`; 401 on mismatch/missing; return 200 immediately and hand the parsed payload to a worker pool (mirror the `SIO_POOL` pattern).
2. `codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/webhook.py`:
   - normalize `entry[].changes[].value` into `InboundEvent` objects: `MessageEvent` (text, image, document, audio, location, reaction, button/interactive), `StatusEvent` (sent/delivered/read/failed), `GroupEvent` (participant added/removed, group created/deleted, join request).
   - extract `messages[].id`, `from`, `timestamp`, `context.id` (reply-to), `group_id` when present, and media ids.
   - idempotency: bounded per-project set of processed external message ids (persisted next to the channel store) so Meta retries do not duplicate messages.
   - unknown/unsupported types: log at info level, never raise.
3. Register the router in `codx/junior/app.py` (`app.include_router(channels_router, prefix="/api")`).

## Files
- codx/junior/api/channels.py (new)
- codx/junior/channels/whatsapp/webhook.py (new)
- codx/junior/app.py

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Handshake returns the challenge for the right verify token, 403 for the wrong one.
- [ ] Valid signature accepted, invalid/missing signature rejected with 401 (tests with real HMAC vectors).
- [ ] Handler returns 200 in < 300 ms (no blocking I/O in the request path).
- [ ] Text/image/document/audio/status/group payload fixtures parsed correctly.
- [ ] Replayed webhook with the same message id is a no-op.
